intro: Pozzik, the head goblin engineer out at the Mirage Raceway, needs materials to shave critical ounces off his rocket-car chassis. Rather than relying purely on heavy metal plating, the goblins salvage hollow bones from local desert vultures to build sturdy, ultralight steering and structural rigs.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: When it comes to racing, every bit counts! Whether it's a minor tweaking on the power output, a slight slackening on the tension coils, or lightening the weight of the frame, you have to take everything into account.

We use vulture bones for a lot of the minor structural tweaks we make to our racers, which offer the perfect balance of strength and weight. Even better, it's easy for us to get more, as the salt flats are littered with vultures.
Bring me some and I'll give you a good price on them.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have those bones for me? I was just about to start working on lightening the steering rig, but I don't want to open her up without all the parts I need.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Great! I can get the crew working on this right away. Thanks, friend!
